description: This file defines chart configuration objects, color palettes, layout options, and data transformation utilities for dashboard visualizations in a web application.

methods.name: transformTimeSeriesData
methods.description: Transforms raw time series data into datasets suitable for line charts, with configurable metrics.

methods.name: transformPlatformData
methods.description: Transforms platform-specific data into a format suitable for pie/doughnut charts.

methods.name: transformFunnelData
methods.description: Transforms funnel stage data into a format suitable for funnel visualizations.

methods.name: transformGeoData
methods.description: Transforms geographic data into coordinate-based data for heatmap visualizations.
